verdict.rationale: Paxos exposes webhooks for asynchronous event notification and 'rule-based orchestrations' (e.g., mint) that automatically trigger fiat-to-crypto conversion upon a bank transfer event, which is a concrete instance of event-triggered automation. However, these are pre-built orchestration types (mint/redeem) rather than a general user-definable rules engine, and webhooks only deliver events for the user's own external system to act on rather than triggering actions within Paxos itself. Missing for 10: a documented rules/condition-builder UI or API letting users define arbitrary custom trigger-action logic, and evidence of AI-native/agentic configuration of such rules.
